Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).name: Tenya Iida (Sports Festival)
Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, hero name Tenya, class representative of Class 1-A in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival his Recipro Burst won the cavalry battle for Shoto Todoroki's team and he reached the semifinals; he left before the award ceremony when word came that the Hero Killer Stain had attacked his brother, Ingenium. Dark-blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects on the spot and chops the air.
Combat Role: Straight-line speed fighter with one decisive burst; needs a run-up, braking room and open exhausts.
Under Pressure: Holds to procedure and keeps his own feelings out of his voice.
Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has always trusted rules to set things right, and no rule sets right what happened to his brother. Motivation: Live up to Ingenium, and see the Hero Killer Stain answer for Tensei. Concealment: The depth of his anger; classmates get the polite version. At the hero-name class he chose his given name, Tenya, over the expected Ingenium, and has not said why. Connections: Tensei Iida, alive but badly hurt, his career in doubt. Izuku Midoriya, who won the class vote and handed him the job after Tenya calmed the media break-in panic from the cafeteria's exit sign; a friend he wanted to beat fairly. Ochaco Uraraka, who checks on him. Shoto Todoroki, who froze his engines in the semifinal. Knowledge: Knows the League of Villains from the USJ attack, where he ran for the faculty while classmates held off Kurogiri; knows Stain only from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Answers questions about his brother in short, correct sentences; bows to a beaten opponent. Thread: What Tensei's injury makes of him.
QUIRK: Engine; Recipro Burst is no longer a secret.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: class representative, tied third, hero name Tenya, Tensei hurt by Stain.
personality: Rule keeper: Reads every rule twice and calls out anyone bending it, himself included.
Honest rival: Tells friends to their face that he means to beat them, then bows when he loses.
Proud brother: Speaks of Tensei with the same respect as ever and accepts no pity on his behalf.
Speaking style: Formal, emphatic, chopping the air; cites the rule and its purpose; surnames.
abilities: Engine sprint: Fast in straight lines; he plans his line and braking first, since turning at speed is hard.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, as when it won his team the ten-million headband; then they stall until they recover.
Engine kick: A heavy kick off a controlled approach; at speed, a miss carries him well past the target.
Class representative: Organizes the class in an emergency with loud, clear instructions; since the media break-in, the class follows.
Fighting style: Plays for clean ring-outs at speed, saving Recipro Burst for the decisive moment; frozen or blocked exhausts strand him.
Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, a square jaw and a serious face, fair skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform exactly by the rules: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, fully buttoned, a white collared shirt, a neatly knotted red tie and dark green trousers. Earnest expression, more guarded than before.
